name: In the Shadow of the Versipellis
source:
Throughout history we've heard stories about strange and terrifying creatures. Those that change their shape by the moonlight, suck the blood of the innocent or lure the unsuspecting to their death. 

In the modern age, these creatures are purely fantasy. Or are they? 

For countless generations an organization known as the APS (Anomalous Protection Society) has secretly walked a path between the human world and that of the anomalous. Its goal is to protect humans from harm and to preserve the existence of these rare anomalies. A balance that's not easily kept. 

You play as Sean Desmond, a young and newly instated agent of the APS, struggling to come to grips with the recent and brutal death of his partner. His first assignment takes him back to his hometown, where he must face the ghosts of his past, unravel a series of deadly murders, and uncover a plot within his own organization that could jeopardize everyone he holds dear. 

Caught in the middle are three unique and unlikely allies that must work together if they are to survive, but are some grudges too deep? Your actions will dictate how the story will end! 

Who will you choose to save? Who will be by your side when the world turns against you? Will you choose revenge or forgiveness? 

Find out - In The Shadow of the Versipellis

A thrilling 18+ visual novel of crime, passion and transformation
translation:
纵观历史，我们听过关于奇怪而可怕的生物的故事。那些在月光下改变形状的生物，吸食无辜者的鲜血，或者引诱毫无戒心的人死亡。

在现代，这些生物纯粹是幻想。或者他们是吗？

无数代以来，一个被称为APS（异常保护协会）的组织秘密地走在人类世界和异常世界之间的道路上。其目标是保护人类免受伤害并保护这些罕见异常现象的存在。一个不容易保持的平衡。

你扮演肖恩·德斯蒙德 (Sean Desmond)，一位年轻的新上任的APS特工，努力应对他的搭档最近惨死的事实。他的第一项任务是回到家乡，在那里他必须面对过去的阴魂，揭开一系列致命谋杀案，并揭露他自己组织中可能危及他所珍视的每个人的阴谋。

夹在中间的是三个独特且不太可能的盟友，如果他们想要生存就必须共同努力，但有些恩怨是否太深了？你的行动将决定故事的结局！

你会选择拯救谁？当世界与你作对时，谁会在你身边？你会选择复仇还是原谅？

找出答案 - 在维西佩利斯的阴影中

一部18岁以上惊心动魄的视觉小说，内容涉及犯罪、激情和转型
